items.name: The Silence of the Lambs
clues: A psychological thriller: a young trainee needs help from a very dangerous prisoner.
Early 1990s. It won the five biggest Oscars, including Best Picture.
Jodie Foster and Anthony Hopkins.
A pale woman’s face, looking straight at you, with a moth covering her mouth.
Look closely at the skull on the moth’s back: it’s made of human bodies, copied from a 1951 photo with Salvador Dalí.
Hannibal Lecter. The title is about young sheep going quiet.

items.name: Jurassic Park
clues: Adventure and science fiction, with lots of running and screaming.
1993, directed by Steven Spielberg.
The real stars of the poster aren’t people at all.
A black skeleton of a huge animal inside a red and yellow circle.
The logo first appeared on the cover of the novel, designed by Chip Kidd, and the film kept it. Usually it’s the other way round.
A theme park on an island, full of dinosaurs. What could go wrong?

items.name: Pulp Fiction
clues: Crime, violence, lots of talking, and stories told out of order.
1994. It won the top prize at the Cannes Film Festival.
John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson and Uma Thurman.
A woman with a black bob lies on a bed, smoking, with a book in front of her.
It’s made to look like a cheap old crime magazine, with a price on it and worn edges, as if it’s been in someone’s pocket.
Directed by Quentin Tarantino. Its title is another name for cheap crime stories.

items.name: It (2017)
clues: Horror, based on a famous Stephen King novel.
2017. It became one of the most successful horror films ever.
A group of kids who call themselves ‘the Losers’ Club’.
A small boy in a yellow raincoat holds a red balloon. Behind the balloon you can see a face.
The teaser poster’s tagline: ‘You’ll float too.’
Pennywise, the clown who lives in the sewers. The title has only two letters.

items.name: Get Out
clues: Horror, but also a sharp satire, and very funny in places.
2017. Jordan Peele’s first film as director, and it won the Oscar for Best Original Screenplay.
Daniel Kaluuya.
A young man’s face, eyes wide open, with tears running down his cheeks.
In the film, the sound of a spoon in a teacup is enough to send him to ‘the sunken place’.
A weekend visiting his girlfriend’s parents goes very wrong. The title is what the audience shouts at the screen: leave!

items.name: Titanic
clues: A romance and a disaster film, and over three hours long.
1997. It won 11 Oscars.
Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet.
Two faces above the front of a huge ship.
The tagline: ‘Nothing on Earth could come between them.’
A ship that hit an iceberg in 1912, and Celine Dion singing ‘My Heart Will Go On’.
